title: Marketing — Entrada/Saída
prompt: Create a high-fidelity web app screenshot, 1600x1000, desktop, GO Itaim existing Portuguese internal dashboard, design language “Folhas de Operação”: ivory paper, dark forest sidebar, sage green, graphite, muted blue-green accents only, hairline rules and restrained table cards. Browser-free screenshot. Persistent sidebar with GO Itaim brand and existing groups: Principal Visão Geral/Análise/UTR/Comparação; Operacional Entregadores/Valores/Prioridade | Promo/Evolução/Dedicado; Marketing Operacional Marketing/Marketing selected. Across the top of workspace put compact scrollable city/date ticker, arrow controls, entries Guarulhos · 14/09, Manaus · 15/09, São Paulo 2.0 · 16/09, Sorocaba · 17/09. Marketing page header card with MARKETING eyebrow, heading “Marketing”, helper “Gerencie campanhas e acompanhe os resultados da operação.”, exact internal tabs Valores por Cidade, Entrada/Saída active, Apresentação. Main subpage title “Fluxo de Entrada e Saída”, subtitle “Análise de adesão e desligamento de entregadores”. Show a real dedicated filter panel with four compact quick actions “Esta semana”, “Este mês”, “Este trimestre”, “Este ano”; labeled controls “Data inicial” 01/09/2025, “Data final” 14/09/2025, “Praça” Todas; buttons “Limpar Filtros” and filled “Aplicar Filtros”; active-filter summary chip “01/09/2025 — 14/09/2025 · Todas as praças”. Below show data results in a clean three-card row: Entradas 84, Retomada 21, Saídas 37, each with small period delta; then a large readable time-series chart “Movimentação de entregadores” showing incoming, reactivated and departures over four weeks, plus a compact breakdown table by city below or to right. Ensure a clear relationship between date range, plaza filter and resulting metrics. Portuguese labels with correct accents, crisp UI text, no chart over decoration. All values are demo examples. No watermark.
